newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Power to sell $175 mln securities.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Power to sell $175 mln securities.

text.p: Georgia Power Co said Thursday it plans to sell $175 million of preferred securities of its Georgia Power Capital Trust II.

The seven million preferred securities are to be initially offered to the public at $25 per security, it said. Quarterly distributions on the preferred securities are to be payable at the rate of 7.6 percent per year.
The company said the closing of the sale of the securities is scheduled for January 16.

Georgia Power said the proceeds are to be used to fund the full redemption on February 10 of the $7.72 preferred stock at the redemption price of $103.51 per share, and to reduce outstanding short-term debt.
